hotels.title: Australian Outback Boutique Escape with Daily Breakfast & Kyra Sandhills Tours
hotels.description: Deep in Outback Queensland's Channel Country between Eromanga and Quilpie, Toogunna Plains Farmstay offers a unique escape where you can slow down and reconnect with nature. Sprawling across 130,000 acres of breathtaking, wide-open outback, this property showcases the true spirit of remote Australia. Stay in one of just sixteen ensuite huts, offering a rustic feel paired with genuine comfort, including premium bedding, rejuvenating rainwater showers and cosy verandahs built for sundowners. The Bush Kitchen, communal fire pit and herb garden pull everyone together for long, lazy evenings under starry skies. Throughout your stay, choose from two unique tours: a three-hour station adventure through abandoned homesteads, shearing sheds and oil fields with home-baked smoko along the way; or a sunset tour where rolling red sandhills put on a show of colour over drinks and cheese platters.
